title: A Constraint-Lifting Framework for Safe and Stable Nonlinear Control
summary: This paper presents a constraint-lifting control framework for designing stabilizing controllers that guarantee the forward invariance of a prescribed safe set. State-of-the-art safety-enforcing methods, such as control barrier functions (CBFs) and model predictive control (MPC), typically rely on solving constrained optimization problems in real time and therefore may not yield an explicit control law that guarantees constraint satisfaction under all conditions.
